tier: display/audit — MEASUREMENT ONLY. Nothing here ranks, sizes, gates or admits.

definitions.limit_up_close: PRIMARY (strict): close >= round(prev_close*(1+w), 2). The market-true rule and the committed house tape's rule.
definitions.limit_up_close_tolerant: close >= round(prev_close*(1+w),2) * (1 - 0.002) — the build charter's at-or-within-0.2% wording, measured in full and reported in parallel, NOT used as the headline.
definitions.why_strict_is_primary: MEASURED, not assumed: the 0.2% tolerance is not a rounding cushion. On a 10% board it admits every close from ~+9.78% to +10.00%, giving 2.0x the strict event count, and it absorbs most of the near-limit class the charter asks us to count separately (main-board near-limit-up falls from ~19k under strict to 1.6k under tolerant, which would starve pre-registered feature f5). Both definitions are carried through Stage 1 and Stage 2; Stage 3 uses strict with a tolerant-target robustness column.
definitions.near_limit_up: return >= 0.95 * w (9.5% on a 10% board, 19% on a 20% board) AND not a STRICT limit close
definitions.lianban_N: consecutive limit-up closes ending on the bar; any non-limit bar, including an excluded one, resets it to 0
definitions.w: engine.china_microstructure.limit_width_for_date — star 20%, chinext 20% on/after 2020-08-24 else 10%, main 10%, bse 30%

convention_note: Board + width resolved by engine.china_microstructure.limit_width_for_date / _board_from_ticker (imported). A SECOND implementation exists at engine/china_signals.py:37-50 (board_type) which is neither era-aware (returns 20% for a ChiNext name on any date, including before CHINEXT_WIDE_DATE 2020-08-24) nor ST-aware (never narrows to 5%). That one feeds scripts/build_china_library.py -> cn_snapshot -> data/china_pick_lab/fires.jsonl, which is why fires.jsonl carries only widths {10.0, 20.0} and never 5.0. This instrument uses the era-aware module, so its widths will not match fires.jsonl on pre-2020-08-24 ChiNext bars.

exclusions.st_cohort: ALL dates for every ticker in data/china_st/st_snapshot.parquet. That store carries one asof (2026-07-06) and no membership history, so a per-date 5% band is not reconstructible.
exclusions.st_exclusion_is_near_vacuous: MEASURED: only 1 of the 100 current ST names exists in data/china_stocks_raw, so this exclusion removes exactly one ticker. That is not a clean bill of health — it is the universe telling us it does not carry the ST cohort at all (see universe_is_curated). The 5%-band problem is therefore not solved here, it is absent from the sample.
exclusions.st_residual_caveat: Names that WERE ST historically but are not ST today remain in the sample at a 10% band. This is not fixable with the stores we hold and is not patched over.
exclusions.universe_is_curated: THE BINDING COVERAGE FACT. data/china_stocks_raw holds 1,842 names; the A-share market is roughly 5,400. Two independent measurements of the gap: (a) 1 of 100 current ST names is present; (b) of the 1,770 names that hit the limit-up pool in data/china_zt_pool's 47-session window, only 514 (29%) are in this store, and only 24.7% of that store's rows find a match here. Every count and every base rate below describes a CURATED large/mid-cap universe, not the A-share market — and the 打板 game lives disproportionately in exactly the small-cap and ST names this universe omits. Do not read these as market-wide.
exclusions.ipo_windows: STAR/ChiNext first 5 sessions (no band during the 44% cap regime); pre-2014 listings first 1 session. Every ticker's first bar is independently unusable (no prev_close).
exclusions.exdiv_suspect: |open - prev_close| / prev_close > 1.5*w — an ex-dividend or ex-rights gap on a nominal tape is not a limit event.
exclusions.survivorship: data/china_stocks_raw holds the CURRENT listed universe. Delisted names are absent, which biases the limit-DOWN numbers most: the terminal down-limit runs of delisted names are simply not here. Read every limit-down cell as a survivors-only figure.

meta.raw_store: data/china_stocks_raw (nominal/unadjusted OHLCV — the correct basis; data/china_stocks is split/dividend adjusted and would fabricate limit misses)

sector_map.caveat: CURRENT sector membership applied to 15 years of history — sector reclassification is not reconstructible from this store.

parity_gate.note: Residual disagreement is expected and explained: this instrument additionally drops zero-volume bars, and resolves the IPO window from the ticker's FULL history rather than post-window-filter as the module does (the module's first_bar_global is computed after its own date filter, so it drops one extra bar for every pre-2011 listing).

crosscheck_limit_events_tape.tape_history_gap_finding: SIDE FINDING, reported not acted on: for these names the committed limit_events.parquet holds only events from roughly 2026-07 onward and no earlier history, while the raw store supports a full 2011-forward record. The tape's own backfill flag is True for all 3,751 of its market-days, so the flag does not surface the hole. Consistent with a raw-price repair (adjusted -> nominal) landing after the one-time historical backfill, with the nightly appender only ever adding new dates. This instrument does not touch the tape; the CN data-plane owner should.
crosscheck_limit_events_tape.note: Shared-universe comparison; the strict column is the like-for-like one. The aggregate delta is NOT spread across the book — per ticker, 1465 of 1507 names (97.21%) match the tape EXACTLY. Essentially the whole delta is carried by a handful of names where the tape holds only recent (2026-07 onward) events and no earlier history at all, while this instrument recomputes their full record from the raw store. See tape_history_gap_names. The detector itself is pinned at 100% by the STAGE 0 parity gate, which calls the module directly on the same signature.

crosscheck_zt_pool.note: zt_pool is an independent vendor scrape covering 2026-06-15 forward. Rows in zt_pool with no match here are names outside our 1.8k-ticker raw store or ST names we exclude, not detection misses per se.

definitions.conditioning: rows where the name closed at the limit on day T with 连板 == N
definitions.target: the name closes at the limit again on its NEXT usable bar (T+1)
definitions.pair_rule: T and T+1 must be <= 10 calendar days apart (A-share suspensions otherwise masquerade as tomorrow)

stage2_base_rates.ladder_reading_note: The N ladder is a CONDITIONED-ON-REACHING table, not a per-run survival curve. A run that reached 8 boards contributes a row at N=1..7, every one of which continued, so high-N cells are dominated by the runs that were already long. Read a cell as 'a day inside an N-board run is followed by another board X% of the time', never as 'the Nth board continues X% of the time'. N=8 is a tail bucket pooling 8+.
stage2_base_rates.per_name_reading_note: The per-name-first estimator needs >= 10 conditioning events in the SAME cell for a name to contribute. Only N=1 (and N=2 on main/chinext) clears that floor for a meaningful number of names; at high N the qualifying names are, by construction, the serial-limit names, so those per-name medians are a selected sub-population and are NOT a check on the pooled number. They are printed with their name count so the thinness is visible rather than inferred.

preregistered_features.f1_vol_z20: volume z-score of the T-1 bar vs its own prior 20 bars
preregistered_features.f2_turnover_ratio: turnover ratio (volume / shares outstanding) at T-1
preregistered_features.f4_sector_heat: same-day sector limit-up count at T-1, leave-one-out
preregistered_features.f5_near_limit_prev: prior-session near-limit flag: near-limit-up at T-1
preregistered_features.f6_gap_pct: gap at the T-1 open: open[T-1] / close[T-2] - 1
preregistered_features.f7_dist_52w_low: distance from the 52w low: close[T-1] / min(low, 252 bars) - 1
preregistered_features.f8_consec_up_days: consecutive up-close days ending at T-1

stage3_preregistered_features.target: limit_up_close at T (the bar AFTER the feature bar)

time_split.rule: first 70% of trading dates fit / inspect; last 30% REPORTED as holdout

f2_turnover_ratio.status: NULL — NOT MEASURABLE on this basis
f2_turnover_ratio.reason: A turnover ratio needs shares outstanding (or free float) PER DATE. No CN store carries one: data/china_stocks_raw has OHLCV only; data/china_fundamentals/fundamentals.parquet is a 4-asof payload blob with no share-count series; data/china_search/members.parquet carries a single CURRENT mktcap_yi; data/china_participation/tape.parquet is market-level. Applying a current share count to a 2013 bar is a knowingly wrong denominator (A-share counts grow materially through placements and conversions), so no proxy was substituted.
f2_turnover_ratio.note: The pre-registered set stays at eight. This feature is printed null rather than silently swapped for a ninth — the swap is the false-discovery move this design exists to block. The collector that would unblock it is in STAGE 4.
f2_turnover_ratio.partial_coverage: data/china_zt_pool/pool.parquet carries turnover_pct for limit-up names only, 2026-06-15 forward (47 dates) — a conditioned-on-the-outcome sample, unusable as a T-1 predictor.

per_name_availability.note: When this is 0 the per-name-first column is a MEASURED null, not a bug: at this board's base rate a name simply does not accumulate enough limit-ups in the holdout to estimate its own decile curve.

chinext_band_era_control.rule: chinext rows on/after CHINEXT_WIDE_DATE 2020-08-24 (the ±20% band era), re-split 70/30 within that era

stage4_data_gaps.gap: closing-auction order imbalance (14:57-15:00 集合竞价)
stage4_data_gaps.why_it_matters: The seal that holds into the close is decided in the closing auction. A daily bar records the outcome and destroys the mechanism: a name sealed with a thin queue and a name sealed with a wall are the same row here.
stage4_data_gaps.proposal: Collector: per-ticker closing-auction matched volume + unmatched imbalance (direction and size) at 15:00, daily snapshot, ~5k rows/day.
stage4_data_gaps.expected_discriminative_value: HIGH for T+1 continuation, the one question STAGE 2 measures and cannot explain: imbalance size is the direct observable behind whether a seal survives the open.

stage4_data_gaps.gap: 封单量 — resting order-wall volume at the limit price
stage4_data_gaps.why_it_matters: The single most-watched 打板 number in the market, and the one input every practitioner conditions on. We have it for 47 dates (data/china_zt_pool, seal_fund_yi) and for no date before 2026-06-15.
stage4_data_gaps.proposal: Collector: extend the existing zt_pool scrape to persist seal_fund_yi, failed_seals and turnover_pct as an APPEND-ONLY daily tape, and backfill from any vendor with history. Already-running scrape, storage change only.
stage4_data_gaps.expected_discriminative_value: HIGHEST of the four. It is the direct measure of demand left unfilled at the limit; without it, 'limit-up' pools a 100x range of conviction into one flag.

stage4_data_gaps.gap: intraday first-touch time and seal stability
stage4_data_gaps.why_it_matters: A 09:31 seal that never breaks and a 14:55 seal are the same daily row. STAGE 1's near_limit and failed-seal counts are the crudest possible proxy for a distinction that is continuous.
stage4_data_gaps.proposal: Collector: per-limit-event intraday summary — first touch timestamp, count of seal breaks, cumulative minutes sealed, final seal time. Requires minute bars for limit names only (~50-300 names/day), not the whole universe.
stage4_data_gaps.expected_discriminative_value: MEDIUM-HIGH for continuation; first-touch time is the standard practitioner split (一字/秒板 vs 尾盘板) and is currently entirely invisible to us.

stage4_data_gaps.gap: T+0 intraday turnover composition (who traded, at what size)
stage4_data_gaps.why_it_matters: A-share T+1 settlement means the day's buyers cannot sell until tomorrow — the T+1 continuation base rates in STAGE 2 are a direct function of who is locked in. Order-size-bucketed flow (大单/中单/小单) is the standard decomposition and we hold none of it per name per day.
stage4_data_gaps.proposal: Collector: per-ticker daily order-size-bucketed net flow. data/china_lhb (龙虎榜) already lands a related disclosure for a small qualifying subset — the proposal is the universe-wide daily version, not a re-scrape of LHB.
stage4_data_gaps.expected_discriminative_value: MEDIUM. Plausibly the mechanism behind f4 (cohort heat), but it is the most vendor-dependent and least verifiable of the four; ranked last deliberately.
